verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing's own docs say it supports both commercial and consumer card programs, so it is more than a single prepaid rail. The pack never names the specific card types the story asks for (debit, prepaid, commercial credit, consumer credit), and the HN prepaid comment is only a question. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of debit, prepaid, commercial credit and consumer credit card types; detail on how each program is structured or funded; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the platform supports the card types my product needs — debit, prepaid, commercial credit, and consumer credit programs — not just one prepaid rail

citations.quote: Stripe Issuing allows you to create a commercial or consumer card program for your users without setup fees.
